text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Il coordonne les activités des offices", "gist": "The Secretariat General coordinates the activities of the offices"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il prépare en outre les affaires du Conseil fédéral", "gist": "It also prepares the Federal Council's business"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il accompagne la planification politique", "gist": "It accompanies political planning"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il sert d'interface au Parlement", "gist": "It serves as an interface to Parliament"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il garantit une communication cohérente à l'interne et vis-à-vis de l'extérieur", "gist": "It ensures consistent communication internally and externally"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Il est responsable de la gestion des ressources du département", "gist": "It is responsible for managing the department's resources"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Il assume son rôle de propriétaire vis-à-vis de la Poste, des CFF, de Swisscom et de Skyguide", "gist": "It assumes its role as owner for Post, SBB, Swisscom and Skyguide"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Il veille à la réalisation des objectifs stratégiques qui leur sont assignés par le Conseil fédéral", "gist": "It ensures the achievement of strategic objectives assigned by the Federal Council"}]}
